text:
maya: Thanks everyone for the questions in today's all-hands. Quick thread to answer the ones we didn't get to. I'll handle product/strategy bits, @sam will jump in on GTM and pricing.

sam: Quick note — our short thesis: 'we win on serving' not model ownership. That means investments where customers feel predictable latency/cost/security. Not trying to be everything to everyone.

li: Can you say more about Hosted vs Dedicated prioritization? We had a bunch of product asks.

maya: Sure. Hosted = fastest onboarding and high-velocity PLG growth. Dedicated = when customers need predictability + isolation (SLA). Prioritize Hosted for small-mid customers; Dedicated ramps with usage signals and tailored contracts.

jordan: What about Private deployments? Enterprise legal keeps asking about on-prem options and KMS.

maya: Private is strategic for regulated industries. We're shipping a hardened VPC/on-prem package later this quarter with KMS/HSM and audit logs. Not aimed at every account — heavy sales motion.

eva: Curious on competitor posture — how do we position vs cloud vendors that offer managed endpoints?

maya: Short answer: we sell the inference layer and ops experience. Big clouds have infra scale but poor unit economics + ops for LLM-specific needs. We emphasize model switching, cost controls (batching/quantization), and rollouts/observability.

sam: On pricing: Hosted remains usage-based per-token + embeddings. Dedicated moves to reserved capacity contracts. We're exploring volume discounts and eval credits for platform teams.

carla: For engineering — any change in priorities? More infra work?

maya: Yes — next 12 weeks focus: (1) reliability SLOs, (2) rollout tooling, (3) Private deployment checklist. Keep low-latency work ongoing. We won't freeze new feature dev but will funnel infra support resources.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary for private-deploy package succeeded in staging — build #2026.

li: Thanks. Will the roadmap doc be updated?

maya: I'll post the updated roadmap and an FAQ with the answers here by EOD. Link: https://redwood.ai/internal/all-hands/serving-playbook (draft)

sam: If you have specific sales asks (contracts/SLAs) DM me so we can triage.

maya: Thanks all — please react with :thumbsup: if this helped or drop follow-ups below.
